name: socio-economic-dash
description: Maharashtra socio-economic dashboard (GDDP + District Statistical Abstract)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node -e "const f=require('fs');if(!f.existsSync('backend/.env'))f.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env')"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:nodb: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && cd frontend && npx tsc -b
